colors.name: studio-floor

colors.name: studio-rise
colors.role: the floor's color as it lifts into the cyclorama backdrop; the radial vignette rises from floor toward this

colors.name: ink
colors.role: the deepest shadow — turntable base, contact shadow core, footer well (≈19:1)

colors.name: ember
colors.role: the studio's hero accent, focus ring, the default colorway swatch, every key call-out (4.9:1 on floor at large size; used for display/labels, never small body text without scrim)

colors.name: ocean
colors.role: second colorway swatch; the rim-light tint the studio borrows on cool readouts (4.6:1 on floor — labels only)

colors.name: frost
colors.role: third colorway swatch; primary text over the dark floor (14.6:1) and the studio's specular highlight color

colors.name: frost-dim
colors.role: secondary text — frost at 60% alpha over floor (7.0:1); captions, Korean glosses, kicker halves

colors.name: key-light
colors.role: the warm key light tinting the sneaker's lit side and the specular hot spot

colors.name: rim-light
colors.role: the cool rim light raking the shadow side, the floor reflection's cool edge

colors.name: hairline

fonts.role: technical display — hero wordmark ORBIT, section numbers, spec readouts, colorway names; the configurator's instrument voice
body and UI — captions, copy, labels, buttons; pairs with the Korean body face
Korean-first body and subheads — every Korean line lives here, never falling through to the default sans stack

texture: A studio built in code, in three layers stacked, never all visible at once. (1) The seamless: a CSS radial-gradient cyclorama — floor #1a1a22 rising into #2a2a36, vignette darkening at the corners, a soft key-light pool warm #fff5e6 stage-right and a rim pool cool #b8d8ff stage-left — the no-JS view and the canvas understudy. (2) The turntable: a DPR-capped canvas drawing the sneaker procedurally at 36 angles (every 10°), each angle a side-elevation silhouette built from layered path fills (sole, midsole, upper, swoosh, laces, collar) with a per-angle occlusion term and a specular streak that travels with the key light — frames are blended cross-fade on drag so 36 discrete angles read as continuous orbit. (3) The contact: an elliptical radial-gradient shadow under the sneaker that foreshortens and re-centers with rotation, plus a floor reflection of the silhouette at low alpha, vertically compressed — both DOM layers over the seamless, under the canvas. dpr capped at 2, dt clamped; the whole scene pauses offscreen and on hidden tabs.

motion.name: ease-out-settle
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) — orbit inertia and reveals: fast in, long settle

motion.name: orbit inertia
motion.value: release: angular velocity × 0.96/frame (60fps-normalized), decaying to a stop in ~1.4s; drag is 1:1 with pointer delta

motion.name: angle lerp
motion.value: 0.32/frame toward the target angle — the sprite chases the drag, never tearing past it; under reduced motion the lerp is removed (1:1, no inertia)

motion.name: specular travel
motion.value: highlight x = 0.5 + 0.34·sin(angle − keyAzimuth); the streak crosses the upper as the shoe turns — the read of 'real' light

motion.name: shadow foreshorten
motion.value: contact shadow scaleX = 0.78 + 0.22·|cos(angle)|, opacity 0.55→0.8; the shadow breathes with the silhouette's width

motion.name: scroll-scrub pin
motion.value: exploded build pinned 220vh; parts translate on Y by scrollProgress × partOffset, rails draw via clip-path inset; lerp-smoothed 0.18/frame

motion.name: clip wipe
motion.value: colorway panels reveal with direction-aware clip-path inset(), 640ms ease-out-settle, 90ms stagger

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: 700ms ease-out-settle, translateY(20px) → 0, 80ms stagger per observer batch

motion.name: key-light drift
motion.value: after 4s of orbit silence, keyAzimuth advances 0.06 rad/s — the light circles the shoe on its own, so touch gets a living specular
